problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 9 delivery routes through 9 distribution centers.

Each route consists of a sequence of handling tasks represented as (Center, Duration) pairs, where each pair specifies the distribution center where the task must be performed and the time required to complete it. The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the tasks must be executed.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (C6, 1) → (C2, 7) → (C3, 4) → (C5, 7) → (C8, 10) → (C7, 8) → (C1, 5) → (C4, 1) → (C9, 3)
* R2 requires the sequence: (C8, 10) → (C2, 3) → (C6, 4) → (C1, 9) → (C7, 2) → (C5, 1) → (C4, 1) → (C9, 7) → (C3, 7)
* R3 requires the sequence: (C5, 9) → (C3, 6) → (C7, 10) → (C4, 4) → (C1, 1) → (C8, 7) → (C6, 8) → (C2, 9) → (C9, 1)
* R4 requires the sequence: (C4, 2) → (C6, 5) → (C9, 6) → (C8, 6) → (C2, 5) → (C5, 3) → (C1, 3) → (C3, 10) → (C7, 7)
* R5 requires the sequence: (C5, 7) → (C1, 7) → (C4, 3) → (C8, 9) → (C9, 8) → (C7, 10) → (C6, 6) → (C2, 1) → (C3, 10)
* R6 requires the sequence: (C9, 3) → (C4, 3) → (C2, 5) → (C5, 1) → (C8, 6) → (C6, 2) → (C1, 3) → (C3, 10) → (C7, 9)
* R7 requires the sequence: (C3, 10) → (C7, 5) → (C9, 7) → (C1, 1) → (C8, 4) → (C2, 10) → (C6, 5) → (C5, 4) → (C4, 6)
* R8 requires the sequence: (C2, 5) → (C5, 4) → (C4, 6) → (C3, 4) → (C6, 4) → (C1, 4) → (C9, 4) → (C7, 7) → (C8, 2)
* R9 requires the sequence: (C9, 2) → (C5, 5) → (C6, 4) → (C2, 9) → (C3, 5) → (C4, 2) → (C1, 2) → (C8, 9) → (C7, 7)

Each handling task must run continuously once it begins and cannot be interrupted, and each distribution center can only handle one task at a time. The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all tasks across the distribution centers so that the total completion time for all delivery routes is minimized.
